As ''[[Starships and Speeders]]'' states that standard ''Imperial I''-class where not equipped with a communications tower, the ''Ultimatum'' must have been upgraded.</ref>

The '''''Ultimatum''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Rae Sloane]] during the reign of the first [[Galactic Empire]]. Assigned to Death Squadron, the personal flotilla of Darth Vader, the ''Ultimatum''{{'s}} career was cut brutally short when it suffered a direct collision with an asteroid in the Hoth asteroid belt.

==Description==
An [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="Note" /> the [[Starship|ship]] was equipped with a [[communications tower]] and two [[deflector shield generator dome]]s,<ref name="Card Trader" /> as well as [[engine]]s.<ref name="ESB" />

==History==
===Gorse===
[[11 BBY|Eleven]] [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], the ''Ultimatum'' was deployed to [[Gorse]] to assist [[Count]] [[Denetrius Vidian]] in [[mining]] [[thorilide]]. Following the [[Gorse Conflict]], the ''Ultimatum'' was placed under the permanent command of [[Rae Sloane]] from its previous [[commander]], [[Captain]] [[Yale Karlsen]], who was on a construction committee during the conflict.<ref name="AND" />

===Serving Death Squadron===
{{Quote|Asteroids do not concern me, Admiral.|Darth Vader, to Admiral [[Firmus Piett]]|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:ThisCantEndWell-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Ultimatum'' joined Death Squadron by the time the fleet chased the ''Falcon''.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="GA" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War]], the ''Ultimatum'' was under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Commodore]] [[Rae Sloane]], though Captain [[Canonhaus]] was temporarily placed in command whilst Sloane undertook a [[Standard week|weeks]]-long inspection of new [[shuttle]] technology at the [[Fondor Shipyards]].<ref name="Lord Vader" /> The ''Ultimatum'' joined [[Death Squadron]], the personal [[fleet]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], by the [[time]] of the [[Battle of Hoth]], and chased the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' through the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt]] alongside the rest of the fleet.<ref name="Final Order">{{StoryCite|story=The Final Order|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref>

[[File:YouCanProbablyBuffThatOut-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Star Destroyer's command tower was obliterated by an asteroid.]]
During the [[asteroid]] pursuit, the Star Destroyer was serving as an escort to the ''[[Executor]]'', and Canonhaus joined Captain [[Lorth Needa]] and another [[Imperial officer]] in a [[hologram]] report to [[Darth]] Vader. As Needa was relaying the last time the ''Falcon'' appeared in any of his scopes, the ''Ultimatum''{{'s}} [[Conning tower|command tower]] was hit by an asteroid, obliterating it.<ref name="ESB" /> The ship was then instantly engulfed in massive explosions, which destroyed it. As such, the captain's hologram disappeared from Vader's view as he was killed, although the [[Sith Lord]] ignored this disruption.<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> Subsequently, Needa suggested that due to the amount of damage Death Squadron had sustained, the rebel freighter must have been destroyed, although Vader correctly maintained that it was still intact.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Ultimatum'' was created by [[John Jackson Miller]] for his [[2014]] [[canon]] novel, [[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']]. The novel's cover, illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]], provides a visual depiction of the ''Ultimatum''.<ref name="AND" /> The vessel later appeared in [[Seth Dickinson]]'s short story "[[The Final Order]]," published in the [[2020]] anthology, ''[[From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', which confirmed that the Star Destroyer<ref name="The Final Order">{{Twitter|DelReyStarWars|status/1313490464952250375|[[Del Rey]]|quote=They're just asteroids. What possible threat could they pose to a Star Destroyer and its captain? #StarWars #FromaCertainPOVStrikesBack|archivedate=20201006194731}}</ref> that was struck by an asteroid in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="ESB" /> was in fact the ''Ultimatum''.<ref name="The Final Order" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (asteroid collision)|vessel]] first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]] by [[Donald F. Glut]], released prior to the film in 1980.<ref name="Legends novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref>
